verification.ask: Query the account entity and show me the sample records.
verification.expect: Account, Total Records 1,247, Records returned 3 of 1,247, primary key accountid / primary name name; Contoso Ltd (a1b2c3d4-0001, ACC-10001, Technology, revenue 45000000, 320 employees), Fabrikam Inc (a1b2c3d4-0002, ACC-10002, Manufacturing, 89000000, 650), Adventure Works (a1b2c3d4-0003, ACC-10003, Retail, 12000000, 95)

verification.ask: What does the account schema require, and what do I need for a bulk import of accounts?
verification.expect: Schema: logical name account, 12 attributes, 1,247 records; exactly 3 required - accountid (Uniqueidentifier), name (String, max 160), ownerid (Lookup -> systemuser); the other 9 including accountnumber (max 20), websiteurl (max 200) and revenue (Money) are optional. Bulk import: CSV, max batch size 1,000 records, 45 seconds per 1000, duplicate detection on name and accountnumber, required columns name and accountnumber; preview of 500 records finds 12 duplicates, creates 488, estimated 23 seconds
